mechanism_narrative: Lower FEDFUNDS levels correlate with positive S&P 500 20-day returns as reduced discount rates increase equity valuation. The relationship is linear: lower rates predict higher returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 250, high inflation triggers central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in unemployment (UNRATE > 0.1pp 3m change) and fall in industrial production (INDPRO < -1.0% 3m change) signals economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 3.8 AND UNRATE 3m change > 0.1pp AND INDPRO < 110 AND INDPRO 3m change < -1.0%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
